Theorem
[The Metric Topology Is the Manifold Topology]

↗ thm:riemannian-manifolds-metric-spaces ↗ lem:riemannian-distance-locally-small ↗ lem:riemannian-distance-small-implies-nearby

For a connected Riemannian manifold with or without boundary, the topology induced by the metric $d_g$ of Theorem 2 equals the manifold topology.
Proof

↗ lem:riemannian-distance-locally-small ↗ lem:riemannian-distance-small-implies-nearby \sketch If $U$ is manifold-open and $p\in U$, Lemma 15 puts a $d_g$-ball about $p$ inside $U$. Conversely, if a $d_g$-ball of radius $\delta $ about $p$ lies in $U'$, Lemma 15 gives a manifold neighborhood $V$ of $p$ with $d_g(p,q)<\delta $ on $V$, so $V\subseteq U'$.

□
